data.name: Ahtifa
data.gender_notes: Ahtifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is given a great reward or honor, from Allah. The name Ahtifa carries the meaning “Gift, Reward, Honour” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahtifa usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward, honour and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be bestowed with divine blessings.
data.etymology: Ahtifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward, Honour.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahtifa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: احتفا
in_arabic.long_meaning: احتفا اسم ہے جو Arabic root 'ح-ف-ي' سے بنا ہے ۔ اس کا معنی ہے جشن منانا ، خوش ہونا ، یا کسی خاص موقع پر خوشی کا اظہار کرنا ۔ قرآن میں اس جیسے الفاظ کثرت سے ملتے ہیں جو خوشی اور جشن کے حوالے سے ہیں ۔ تاریخی طور پر ، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے جہاں احتفا جیسے مواقع پر خوشی اور تہوار منائے جاتے ہیں ۔ روحانی طور پر ، یہ نام خوشی اور جشن کی حالت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے ۔

in_urdu.name: احتفا
in_urdu.meaning: احتفا کا مطلب ہے جشن یا تہوار
in_urdu.long_meaning: احتفا ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ح-ف-ي' جڑ سے نکلا ہے ۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خوشی کا اظہار کرنا یا کسی خاص موقع پر جشن منانا ۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں ، یہ نام خوشی اور تہواروں کے ساتھ منسلک ہے ۔ اس کا استعمال تاریخی طور پر ان مواقع پر کیا جاتا رہا ہے جہاں مسلمان خوشی اور جشن کا اظہار کرتے ہیں ۔ روحانی طور پر ، یہ نام ایک مثبت اور خوشحال حالت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے ۔

in_hindi.name: अहतिफा
in_hindi.meaning: अहतिफा का अर्थ है उत्सव या जश्न
in_hindi.long_meaning: अहतिफा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है खुशी का इजहार करना या किसी विशेष अवसर पर जश्न मनाना । भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम खुशी और उत्सव से जुड़ा हुआ है । इसका उपयोग ऐतिहासिक रूप से उन अवसरों पर किया जाता रहा है जहां मुसलमान खुशी और जश्न का इजहार करते हैं । आध्यात्मिक रूप से, यह नाम एक सकारात्मक और सुखद स्थिति को दर्शाता है ।

in_pashto.long_meaning: احتفا د عربي نوم دی چی 'ح-ف-ي' ريښی څخه يی اخستي دي ۔ دا د خوښۍ د څرګندولو یا کوم ځانګړي موقع په وخت جشن تلو معنی دی ۔ د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې ، دا نوم د خوښۍ او جشن سره تړلی دی ۔ دا په تاريخي ډول په هغه ځایونو کې کارول کېږي چیرته چې مسلمانان د خوښۍ او جشن اظهار کوي ۔ روحاني طور ، دا نوم د مثبته او خوشحالانه حالت څرګندوي ۔

in_english.name: Ahtifa
in_english.long_meaning: Ahtifa is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ح-ف-ي' (ḥ-f-y), which means to express joy or celebrate a special occasion. Etymologically, it relates to concepts of happiness and festivity found in the Quran and Islamic tradition. Historically, names like Ahtifa have been used in Islamic cultures to signify joy and communal celebrations. Spiritually, the name Ahtifa reflects a state of happiness and festivity, symbolizing positive and uplifting qualities. In modern usage, Ahtifa is chosen for its beautiful meaning and cultural significance across diverse Muslim communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ahtifa" holds a significant cultural value within the Islamic community, as it signifies a bestowal of great honor or reward from Allah. It's a reminder of Allah's generosity and mercy towards his creation.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Ahtifa" serves as a constant reminder for the individual to strive for excellence and constant improvement in their deen (religion). It's a reminder that all success and rewards come from Allah, and that true honor and recognition come from Him alone. By living a righteous life, the individual may be granted 'Ahtifa' or great reward in the hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift, Reward, Honour" symbolizes The one who is given a great reward or honor, from Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ahtifa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift, reward, honour.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ahtifa was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in various hadiths. The name Ahtifa carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: Ahtifa is a name of Arabic origin that is not commonly used in modern times. It is mentioned in various hadiths as the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), and as such holds historical significance for Muslim communities.
